notes: Original Phobos fiction, commissioned by phobosgekko on 6 October 2026; agent-authored choices open to owner revision. Vanilla evidence, literary influences and mechanical limits: docs/development/spacer-stories-vanilla-expansion.md. This pack does not change native plots, gigs, faction scores, station rules or NPCs.

spacertales-freight-estimate-notice.text: A small freight estimators' circle at [place] is collecting examples of contracts whose promised arrival bears little relation to the journey. Its correspondence offers a comparison of waiting, fuel and turnaround costs, with no deposit and no departure deadline. The circle says a large number in the reward column does not make a small number in the time column sensible.
spacertales-freight-estimate-notice.mention: There is a freight circle comparing the deadline with the actual journey. About time.

spacertales-salvage-name-notice.text: An independent records clerk at [place] is seeking readers for a copied salvage account. It separates the owner of a component from the people who fitted it, maintained it and were still owed wages when the vessel changed hands. No title dispute will be decided by the exercise. The clerk says the last page is usually the one that goes missing.
spacertales-salvage-name-notice.mention: Someone is copying the workers' names out of old salvage accounts.

spacertales-berth-address-notice.text: A berth association at [place] is revising a voluntary contact sheet for crews away on long runs. Families have asked that a ship's departure stop being treated as a person's disappearance. The sheet records who will hold a message and who has agreed to receive one. It grants no residency rights and collects no dues through visiting captains.
spacertales-berth-address-notice.mention: The berth association wants away on a run to mean away on a run, not vanished.

spacertales-old-ring-notice.text: Residents at [place] are circulating an account of a maintenance petition with three different dates on its cover. The tenants want the oldest date retained when the copy is refiled. Their copyist says the dispute concerns a particular building account, not a new housing rule, and that a neat replacement cover must not erase how long people have waited.
spacertales-old-ring-notice.mention: An old-ring petition has been recopied so often it has got younger than the people waiting.

spacertales-ceres-wording-notice.text: A freight translator at [place] has opened correspondence about a shipment described as both household effects and used equipment. The descriptions came from different parties with different reasons for writing them. Readers are being offered the two accounts together, without a ruling on duties or ownership. The translator asks captains to read the description before trusting the total.
spacertales-ceres-wording-notice.mention: Two descriptions of the same shipment are going round. Each makes sense until you see the other.

spacertales-titan-yard-notice.text: A family archive at [place] is collecting ordinary yard correspondence: requests for leave, postponed visits and the messages workers sent home after launch days. The archive wants life around the ships preserved beside their specifications. It offers copies, not access to a yard or a military contract.
spacertales-titan-yard-notice.mention: The yard archive is keeping the letters about missed dinners as well as the launch dates.

spacertales-luna-works-notice.text: A voluntary archive at [place] is comparing an unfinished works list with a contractor's closing account. Tools and rooms can remain on Luna long after the work that was meant to fill them has moved elsewhere. The archive seeks no expedition into abandoned sites; it wants someone to read what the contractor called complete.
spacertales-luna-works-notice.mention: There is an archive comparing finished on paper with unfinished on Luna.

spacertales-visa-letter-notice.text: A maintenance worker's correspondence at [place] is available for copying. It sets out the difference between obtaining a work visa and having enough time, money and freedom to enjoy the place it admits you to. The letter concerns one worker's terms. It does not offer a visa, a job or a way around the authorities.
spacertales-visa-letter-notice.mention: There is a maintenance letter about having permission to live somewhere and no time to live there.

spacertales-deimos-shift-notice.text: Night-shift correspondence from [place] describes the staff who keep rented laboratories supplied and open between research shifts. Its author asks readers to keep the service entries beside the project summaries. The account offers no results, restricted access or proof of what any research team was doing.
spacertales-deimos-shift-notice.mention: The laboratory night shift wants to stay in the account after the research team takes the credit.

spacertales-venus-invoice-notice.text: A freight correspondent at [place] is sharing a small collection of invoices issued after a Venusian shipment failed to arrive. The accounts disagree about when a consignment becomes a loss and when a family can stop waiting. The correspondent has removed identifying route details. No surviving crew or missing cargo has been located by the collection.
spacertales-venus-invoice-notice.mention: After a shipment goes missing, the bills arrive more reliably than the answers.

spacertales-europa-letter-notice.text: A family correspondence custodian at [place] is offering a copied exchange about delayed mail and the trade restrictions around Atlantis. The writers disagree about the politics but agree that their family should not have to become a political argument. The copy describes no smuggling route and offers no passage through the blockade.
spacertales-europa-letter-notice.mention: Someone is preserving a family argument about the blockade. They still remembered to ask after each other.

spacertales-hollow-book-notice.text: A dockside account keeper at [place] has released a copy of a disputed meal-and-berth book. One entry was written as a loan by the payer and as wages by the person receiving it. Readers are invited to compare the accounts. No money is being collected and no creditor will be introduced by the correspondence.
spacertales-hollow-book-notice.mention: A dockside book calls the same money a loan on one page and wages on the next.

spacertales-freight-crew-room.text: Several small crews around [place] are circulating their own estimates before bidding for work. The estimates allow for a berth queue and a return journey as well as the outward leg. A broker says this makes quotations harder to compare. A captain says it makes them easier to survive.
spacertales-freight-crew-room.mention: A captain put the return trip in the estimate. The broker called it an extra.

spacertales-salvage-labels.text: A dockside reseller at [place] has begun keeping old maintenance labels with used components. Buyers like the dates; former crew like the names. The reseller warns that a label can be wrong and is not proof of safe operation. Sales staff report that some customers now spend longer reading the label than examining the part.
spacertales-salvage-labels.mention: A parts dealer is keeping the old labels. People want to know who last cared for the thing.

spacertales-berth-quiet-hours.text: Neighbours at [place] have agreed to rotate a quiet meal period between adjoining berths. The arrangement is voluntary and has already produced two competing timetables. One organiser says the aim is simply to let somebody sleep before everybody starts moving supplies again.
spacertales-berth-quiet-hours.mention: The quiet-meal timetable has a rival timetable. Both say they are the quiet one.

spacertales-ring-repair-priority.text: An old-ring residents' sheet at [place] lists a failed cupboard latch beside larger maintenance complaints. Its author says the latch matters because a shift worker sleeps beside it. Another resident has asked that a dripping tap remain on the sheet even when the drip is too small for the contractor's report.
spacertales-ring-repair-priority.mention: The repair sheet kept the little faults on it. You still have to sleep beside them.

spacertales-ceres-empty-case.text: A used-equipment seller at [place] has put an empty transit case in the window with its accumulated shipping labels intact. Passers-by have offered three accounts of its route and none of its contents. The seller says it is for sale as a case, and charges no extra for the stories.
spacertales-ceres-empty-case.mention: That empty case in the window has travelled further than the shopkeeper can prove.

spacertales-titan-small-launch.text: A small yard gathering at [place] marked the launch of a service craft with a meal after shift. The craft's purchaser issued specifications; the workers' notice thanked the people who had covered watches while the delivery ran late. No ship performance record was claimed.
spacertales-titan-small-launch.mention: The launch notice thanked the people covering late watches. That is a specification you can trust.

spacertales-luna-postponed.text: An archive display at [place] pairs a lunar contractor's departure notice with an earlier list of jobs marked temporary. The curator has left the word unchanged. A visitor asked how long temporary can last. The curator says the surviving paperwork does not provide an end date.
spacertales-luna-postponed.mention: An archive has a temporary works list with no end date. Luna kept the works longer than the contractor.

spacertales-visa-shift-cover.text: A maintenance crew at [place] exchanged shifts so one worker could attend a family appointment. Their private arrangement has been recorded in a training scrapbook as an example of cooperation. The crew asked that the entry keep the wages they gave up as well as the hours they gained.
spacertales-visa-shift-cover.mention: The training book praised a shift swap. The crew made it print what the swap cost them.

spacertales-deimos-lost-mug.text: A shared laboratory service desk at [place] reports that its longest-running ownership dispute concerns a chipped mug. Three teams identify it as theirs. The night cleaner identifies the person who actually washes it. The desk has declined to assign research priority to the claim.
spacertales-deimos-lost-mug.mention: Three research teams claim the mug. One cleaner knows who washes it.

spacertales-venus-shore-list.text: A small freight office at [place] has replaced a list labelled waiting cargo with separate lists for delayed, unconfirmed and written-off shipments. Families welcomed the extra detail but asked that written off never be used as a description of a person.
spacertales-venus-shore-list.mention: The freight office split its waiting list. Families asked it to keep people out of the written-off column.

spacertales-europa-common-envelope.text: A family correspondence group at [place] has preserved an envelope used by two relatives on opposite sides of a political argument. Its notes record a corrected address, a recipe and a request for news of a cousin. The group says disagreement is visible on every page, and so is affection.
spacertales-europa-common-envelope.mention: The family letter argues about the blockade, then asks whether the cousin is eating properly.

spacertales-hollow-chair.text: A dockside meal room at [place] has kept a broken chair off its disposal list because the person who repaired its other chairs is away. Nobody claims the chair is valuable. Staff say they would rather ask than discover later that the one thing a regular had wanted kept had been thrown out.
spacertales-hollow-chair.mention: They are keeping a broken chair until its repairer gets back. Nobody asked what it would sell for.

spacertales-estimate-return-report.text: The estimators' circle at [place] has retained a return-journey column in its own sample quotation after the copied comparison was read. The change concerns the circle's correspondence, not the station job board. Its organiser says a captain must still decide whether a particular offer is worth the trip.
spacertales-estimate-return-report.mention: That freight circle kept the return column. The job board is still its own problem.

spacertales-label-names-report.text: A copied maintenance label will accompany the disputed pump sale described in the records correspondence at [place]. The label preserves workers' names and warnings. Ownership and old wages remain separate questions; the records clerk has issued no safety certificate or legal ruling.
spacertales-label-names-report.mention: They kept the pump's old working label. Nobody pretended it settled the wages.

spacertales-address-sheet-report.text: The neighbours' contact sheet at [place] now names willing message-holders without making them responsible for a captain's debts. Misfiled letters from the correspondence case have been found. The agreement is voluntary and concerns the participating neighbours only.
spacertales-address-sheet-report.mention: The letters were found, and the message-holder did not inherit anybody's loan.

spacertales-petition-date-report.text: The original date has been restored to the copied residents' petition at [place]. The contractor acknowledged the packet; the copyist reports no completed repair. The tenants asked that the difference remain explicit when the correspondence was archived.
spacertales-petition-date-report.mention: The petition has its age back. The repair still needs doing.

spacertales-box-paired-report.text: The two freight descriptions in the correspondence at [place] are now being copied together. Sender and broker agreed to retain the item list and the household letter without presenting either as proof of ownership. Their disagreement about value remains.
spacertales-box-paired-report.mention: Both accounts of that box are being kept. They still disagree about the price.

spacertales-yard-family-report.text: The launch-evening archive at [place] now includes the family's letter beside the on-time departure notice. A revised meal invitation saves portions for people covering the last watch. The archive stresses that an invitation is a proposal, not a new yard work rule.
spacertales-yard-family-report.mention: The launch archive kept the missed supper. The next invitation remembers the late watch.

spacertales-luna-list-report.text: The copied lunar works list at [place] is now filed beside the contractor's closing account. It retains the jobs still marked next shift and the workers' meal order. The archive claims no access to the abandoned site and no finding about why work stopped.
spacertales-luna-list-report.mention: The lunar archive kept the next-shift list beside the closing invoice.

spacertales-visa-hours-report.text: The maintenance worker's family correspondence at [place] now keeps the visa terms beside the letters about postponed visits. The copy changes no contract or residency right. Its custodian says both kinds of permission belong in the account.
spacertales-visa-hours-report.mention: The visa letters kept the missed visits as well as the terms.

spacertales-night-work-report.text: The night-service correspondence at [place] has retained the uncertain recording notes and the cleaner's work in the same account. Neither replay nor an unidentified visitor has been established. The staff have asked readers to stop giving the room a supernatural nickname.
spacertales-night-work-report.mention: The tea-room account kept the cleaner's work. It did not identify the extra voice.

spacertales-venus-contact-report.text: The missing-shipment correspondence at [place] now separates the closed cargo claim from the family's return contact. No confirmed news of the crew has arrived. The family asked that the completed copying exercise not be described as the end of their wait.
spacertales-venus-contact-report.mention: The cargo claim closed. The family's return contact stayed open.

spacertales-europa-pair-report.text: The family letters in the correspondence at [place] have been archived together at both writers' request. Their disagreement over the blockade remains, along with corrected addresses and a recipe. No trade restriction or passage permission was changed.
spacertales-europa-pair-report.mention: Both family letters were kept. So were the argument and the recipe.

spacertales-meal-book-report.text: The three copied dockside books at [place] now describe the disputed portion as a meal with shift. The corrected entry retains the earlier charge crossed out, so the disagreement remains visible. No visiting captain paid it.
spacertales-meal-book-report.mention: The cook kept the book. The meal finally stopped being called a loan.

spacertales-waiting-letter-report.text: The unhurried family letter has reached its receiving correspondence at [place]. The reply confirms that the repaired chair is still there. The captain's receipt is paid; no deadline or return delivery follows. The archive has left room for the next ordinary letter.
spacertales-waiting-letter-report.mention: The letter without an arrival date arrived. The chair is still there.

spacertales-ad-real-estimate.text:
BEFORE YOU BID
Compare the outward trip, the return trip and the waiting. A large reward has never shortened an orbit. Independent freight correspondence at [place]; no route or arrival is guaranteed.

spacertales-ad-label-copy.text:
LOOSELEAF DOCK COPIES
A sale card for the buyer. A working copy for the crew. Keep the old warning legible. Independent copying trade at [place].

spacertales-ad-message-holder.text:
LONG WATCH MEALS
A covered portion is a better welcome than an empty pan. Serving the people who get back after everybody else has eaten. Ask what is left before asking what is fashionable.

spacertales-ad-ring-copy.text:
OLD RING DOOR AND DRAWER WORK
Latches, catches and the cupboard everybody walks around. Small jobs are still jobs. Keep your first request date on the next copy.

spacertales-ad-translation.text:
READ BOTH DESCRIPTIONS
Household effects. Used equipment. The same box can carry a different price in every account. Freight correspondence at [place]; no customs advice or clearance offered.

spacertales-ad-yard-family.text:
LAUNCH DAY PORTRAITS
The customer gets a ship photograph. Get one with the people who built it. Late-watch sittings by arrangement. Keep the work clothes; they tell the right story.

spacertales-ad-luna-unfinished.text:
SECOND SHIFT WORK BOOKS
A tough cover for estimates, sketches and the things the next watch needs to know. Blank pages sold without promises that the job will ever finish.

spacertales-ad-visa-correspondence.text:
READ THE HOURS AS WELL AS THE VIEW
A worker's account of maintenance residency at [place]. Correspondence, not recruitment.

spacertales-ad-night-staff.text:
NIGHT BENCH TEA
For the people still there after the project meeting ends. Hot cups, plain portions, no presentation required. Somebody has to wash the mug afterwards.

spacertales-ad-venus-terms.text:
WHEN A SHIPMENT DOES NOT ARRIVE
Keep a copy of the terms before everyone explains them differently. Freight letters at [place]. No recovery service offered.

spacertales-ad-family-mail.text:
TWO SIDES LETTER COPYING
Keep the answer beside the argument. Envelopes large enough for a recipe, a correction and the news you meant to send first.

spacertales-ad-hollow-accounts.text:
DOCKSIDE ACCOUNT BOOKS
Write what it was for before somebody finds a better-sounding name. Plain paper, sturdy covers, room for corrections. Fair weather not included.

spacertales-ad-galley-neighbour.text:
MAKE ROOM FOR SUPPER
Verdemorrow cultivation and galley equipment for ships where a late watch still deserves a meal. Keep the portion aside before somebody claims the last one.

spacertales-talk-freight-two-clocks.line: The offer gives me two days. The journey asks for rather more. I think they should meet before I sign.

spacertales-talk-freight-return.line: A route estimate ends when you can take the next job. Getting there is only part of it.

spacertales-talk-freight-good-money.line: Good money is still good money. I just want to reach the other end alive enough to collect it.

spacertales-talk-freight-job-board.line: The job board found a shorter journey. Apparently it leaves out the ship.

spacertales-talk-salvage-wages.line: The last owner bought the part. The previous crew kept it running. That is why the old label has more names.

spacertales-talk-salvage-title.line: Being allowed to strip a ship does not answer every question about who last lived in it.

spacertales-talk-salvage-memory.line: Keep the old maintenance note until you know the part. Some warnings look like shopping lists.

spacertales-talk-salvage-clean-card.line: The seller called the history spotless. That meant they had thrown it away.

spacertales-talk-berth-friend.line: My neighbour holds my messages when I am away. I hold the complaint about their kettle.

spacertales-talk-berth-home.line: If your home leaves port, which part of the address do you miss?

spacertales-talk-berth-quiet.line: There is no good time to move a crate beside somebody asleep. There is a very popular bad time.

spacertales-talk-berth-room.line: We made room for a visitor at supper. They stayed long enough to become the person making room.

spacertales-talk-ring-date.line: I keep the first date on every repair request. The latch has not got any newer either.

spacertales-talk-ring-tap.line: A small drip is a small problem until you spend your whole sleep shift listening to it.

spacertales-talk-ring-floor.line: That floor has been patched so often I recognise the neighbours by which patch they avoid.

spacertales-talk-ring-window.line: The room came with a view. The landlord did not mention the other person sharing it.

spacertales-talk-ceres-box.line: The description tells you what they want you to pay for. Read the contents as well.

spacertales-talk-ceres-counter.line: Every counter wants the original. There was one original before I started.

spacertales-talk-ceres-two-pens.line: My aunt kept two copies of her account. One showed the charges. The other showed who had been hungry.

spacertales-talk-ceres-neutral.line: If a translation is neutral, why does somebody always ask who paid for it?

spacertales-talk-titan-new-ship.line: The new ship had a crowd at launch. Most of the people who built it were still on shift.

spacertales-talk-titan-tools.line: A state-of-the-art yard still has a person asking who took their spanner.

spacertales-talk-titan-leave.line: I can tell you the launch date months ahead. Getting leave for a family visit is less reliable.

spacertales-talk-titan-name.line: We remember a vessel by who worked beside us on it. The client remembers what it cost.

spacertales-talk-luna-temporary.line: They called the work temporary. The people left before the temporary work did.

spacertales-talk-luna-meal.line: Old lunar accounts list meals beside machinery. I always read the meals first. Somebody expected to finish the shift.

spacertales-talk-luna-unanswered.line: An old access light can mean a lot of things. Do not decide that one of them is an invitation.

spacertales-talk-luna-tourist.line: An abandoned place can be dangerous without needing a story to explain it.

spacertales-talk-visa-view.line: A lovely place to live. I would like a day off to confirm that.

spacertales-talk-visa-cover.line: We swapped watches so she could see her child. The supervisor called it team spirit. We called it Thursday.

spacertales-talk-visa-choice.line: How many choices do you have if leaving costs everything you have put into staying?

spacertales-talk-visa-jetty.line: They showed me the private jetties. I showed them my overtime sheet. Only one of us was fishing.

spacertales-talk-deimos-mug.line: Three teams claimed the mug. Nobody claimed the washing-up.

spacertales-talk-deimos-schedule.line: A research schedule leaves space between projects. A service schedule fills it.

spacertales-talk-deimos-door.line: The project changed its name twice. The person checking the door was the same both times.

spacertales-talk-deimos-noticed.line: When the lab runs smoothly nobody sees us. When the supplies are late everybody does.

spacertales-talk-venus-loss.line: The shipment is unconfirmed. The charge for asking about it is very definite.

spacertales-talk-venus-return.line: A freight clerk wrote returned beside a case. Its owner was still missing. The family made them change the word.

spacertales-talk-venus-weather.line: They can argue about who insured the cargo. I want to know who is still waiting for a person.

spacertales-talk-venus-memory.line: Keep the departure message. People will tell you later that you must have heard something different.

spacertales-talk-europa-post.line: The argument reaches us faster than the family news. Everybody seems to fund the argument.

spacertales-talk-europa-supper.line: They disagreed about everything until the last paragraph. Both wanted the younger cousin to eat properly.

spacertales-talk-europa-water.line: How much distance is there between two people if they keep the same old letter?

spacertales-talk-europa-route.line: I do not need a clever route through somebody's blockade. I need a letter that can wait.

spacertales-talk-hollow-loan.line: They called it a loan after I had already worked for it. That was an expensive change of name.

spacertales-talk-hollow-book.line: Keep your own book. A fair account should survive being compared with someone else's.

spacertales-talk-hollow-chair.line: We kept the broken chair. The regular who fixes it has not been back yet.

spacertales-talk-hollow-credit.line: The cook let me owe a meal. Years later I learned they had been paying for it themselves.

spacertales-crew-journey-choice.line: We can take a good job and still refuse a bad journey. I would like us all back for the next one.

spacertales-crew-ship-address.line: I left a return contact ashore. It feels better than asking everybody to guess where this ship will go.

spacertales-crew-label-history.line: I kept the note that came with that old part. Somebody aboard another ship once cared whether it worked.

spacertales-crew-family-clock.line: Everybody at home has a calendar. A ship gives us an estimate. I wish the two agreed more often.

spacertales-talk-estimate-in-progress.line: The freight comparison you are reading has a return column. I would like that on every offer.

spacertales-talk-letter-on-route.line: That family letter can wait for our own route. I like an errand that leaves the ship to its captain.

spacertales-talk-voice-after-copy.line: I read that tea-room account. A replay would explain it. I would still take company on the watch.

spacertales-talk-return-column-after.line: A return column does not guarantee a fair price. It makes one missing cost harder to hide.

spacertales-talk-optional-grown-supper.line: A Verdemorrow rack makes a fine supper topic. Somebody still has to feed the rack and remember the people eating.

spacertales-talk-optional-flight-estimat.line: Asterel can help with the flying. It cannot persuade a job offer that the journey has got shorter.

spacertales-talk-optional-recovery-label.line: Rivetline kit can help you recover the material. The name on an old label still belongs to somebody's work.

spacertales-tip-old-label.text: A used part may have a longer working history than its sale card admits. Crews keep maintenance labels for warnings, names and the small reminders that the last ship was somebody's home.

spacertales-tip-deadline.text: A profitable offer can still require an impossible journey. Working crews compare the outward leg, the return leg, supplies and time waiting before trusting the reward alone.

spacertales-tip-away-address.text: For a crew living aboard ship, an address may be a trusted person who will hold a message until the next return. Leaving port need not mean leaving every connection behind.

spacertales-tip-small-fault.text: Station maintenance includes faults too small for a grand report: a latch beside a sleeping berth, a persistent drip, a cupboard that everyone has learned to avoid.

spacertales-tip-two-descriptions.text: A consignment can be household effects to the sender, used equipment to a broker and a disputed account to its recipient. The contents may stay the same while the description changes.

spacertales-tip-yard-calendar.text: A shipyard has launch dates, shift rosters and family calendars. A vessel can leave on time while the people who built it miss everything they had planned ashore.

spacertales-tip-luna-accounts.text: Some lunar works outlasted the business that commissioned them. A closing invoice records the end of an account; it does not necessarily describe the end of the work.

spacertales-tip-work-residency.text: A desirable address can make employment terms difficult to refuse. Maintenance workers may hold permission to live in a colony while struggling to find time to enjoy it.

spacertales-tip-service-shift.text: Between research projects, service work continues: supplies, cleaning, access checks and the ordinary tasks a project summary often leaves out.

spacertales-tip-loss-language.text: Written off is an accounting term. Families waiting for missing crew have reasons to object when an office starts using it for people.

spacertales-tip-family-politics.text: A family letter can carry a political argument, a corrected address and concern about supper on the same page. Political borders do not make family feeling conveniently simple.

spacertales-tip-dockside-book.text: Crews keep private accounts because the person paying and the person being paid may disagree about what the payment was for.

spacertales-tip-cascade-memory.text: Earth's dangerous orbital debris is a fact of life in the System. Stories about the people behind a lost address remain personal, incomplete and often contradictory.

spacertales-tip-big-small.text: A great launch, a new contract or a political declaration reaches people through smaller events: an extra watch, a delayed parcel, a missed visit or an unexpected bill.

spacertales-tip-trust-work.text: People who trade together still need records. A fair account makes trust easier to maintain; it does not make memory infallible.

spacertales-tip-distance-letter.text: A letter prepared for an uncertain journey leaves room for the reader to receive it late. The news may age; the wish to be heard need not.
